title: Team op vectors
description: The shape of vectors/team-ops.json, generated by spec/tools/fixtures/team_ops.py. Each vector runs one Teams store op on a world and pins its outcome, the event types it appends and the row changes it makes.

events.description: Every world event once, by id: the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 of its RFC 8785 bytes. An event line without prev_hash.

rows.description: Every world row once, by id (as events).

Constants.description: The Teams constants (spec/schema/README.md, Teams, Constants). Both runtimes pin them as named constants and let tests inject others.

logs.description: Every team log by label. A runner seeds the events under its own header and chains them.

rows.description: The index rows the logs rebuild, per table, sorted by key; team_feed and mail's claim columns left out.

section.description: The design sections (v02 architecture, section 4) the vector pins.

headroom.description: Whether every budget covering the recipient has room for one request of its model. Absent: true.

rules.description: Teams Phase 2: the host's messagePolicy rules, each {from, to, allow}. Absent: none.

templates.description: The dynamic agents the team lists, by name: tools, the template's choosable tools in pinned order; models, its keys, the first the default (spec/schema/README.md, Dynamic members). Absent: none.

lane.description: Teams Phase 2: the sub-lane whose build runs this vector (29D, 29E). A runtime skips a vector with a lane until that build lands; gen_fixtures.py --check runs every vector.

by.description: The label of the log whose writer runs the op (materialize: the new member log's label).

input.description: A model call: call_id and args of a pending tool_call. An operator request: request_id, principal, body (the method's parameters, snake_case, without idempotency_key) and idempotency_key. start adds thread_id, the new member's thread, and for a dynamic agent config_hash, the pin its define gave. deadline: id. materialize: member, label, branch_id, rebind. end: reason, code? (the turn_completed) and result (without member). consume and idle: nothing.

outcome.description: The op's result: the tool's or Team method's result, or consumed / refused (an ended recipient's mail) / nothing_pending, materialized / not_starting / cancelled / rebind_failed, waiting, open, not_due, idle, ended.

appended.description: Per log label, the types of the events the op appended, in order. A log with none is absent.

rows.description: Per table, the rows inserted, the rows updated (as they are after) and the keys of the rows deleted. A table left alone is absent; every appended event also adds its team_feed row.
